description: This source file contains functions to create, populate, and manage error response messages in a USP (Universal Service Protocol) implementation. It includes functions for creating error messages, adding parameter errors, and calculating outer error codes based on inner error conditions.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ERROR_RESP_CreateSingle(char * msg_id,int err_code,Usp__Msg * src_msg)
methods.description: Creates a simple ErrorResponse containing a single error message, freeing the previous message if provided.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * ERROR_RESP_Create(char * msg_id,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Creates a dynamic Error message object with specified message ID, error code, and error message.

methods.name: Usp__Error__ParamError * ERROR_RESP_AddParamError(Usp__Msg * resp,char * path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a parameter error to an existing Error response object, allocating and initializing the param error.

methods.name: int ERROR_RESP_CalcOuterErrCode(int err)
methods.description: Determines the outer error code for a USP error message, especially for set/add/delete response scenarios.
